# Green Imaging

> > Green Imaging provides affordable medical imaging services including MRI, CT scans, and mammograms with transparent pricing and patient-centered care.

Green Imaging is a medical imaging provider focused on making diagnostic imaging accessible and affordable. The organization offers MRI services, CT scans, mammograms, and utilizes PACS technology while maintaining a commitment to transparent healthcare pricing and quality patient care.
